column1: # NACA 4415, clean, in a wind tunnel: lift, pressure drag and moment against angle
# Source: R. L. Reuss Ramsay, M. J. Hoffmann and G. M. Gregorek, "Effects of Surface
#   Roughness and Vortex Generators on the NACA 4415 Airfoil", NREL/TP-442-6472, December
#   1995, Appendix B, Tables B1 (Re 1.0 million) and B2 (Re 1.5 million); measured in the
#   Ohio State University AARL 7x10 subsonic tunnel; nrel.gov/docs/libraries/wind-images/n4415-7x10.pdf
# Not corrected for the tunnel's walls ("The data were not corrected for any tunnel wall
# effects"; tunnel height 6.7 chords). The drag is the PRESSURE (form) drag integrated over
# the model, without the skin friction, and goes slightly negative at low angles: it is not
# a section drag coefficient and is kept for completeness only. Re is the nominal value of
# each table; the runs' own were within 2% of it. Rows from -6 to 16 degrees.
